title: 假設語氣
description: 使用假設語氣表達情境

sentences.en: If I had known about the deadline earlier, I would have allocated more time to complete the research that was required for the proposal.
sentences.zh: 如果我早點知道截止日期，我會分配更多時間來完成提案所需的研究。

sentences.en: Had the government invested in renewable energy decades ago, we would not be facing the severe climate crisis that threatens our planet today.
sentences.zh: 如果政府幾十年前就投資再生能源，我們今天就不會面臨威脅我們星球的嚴重氣候危機。

sentences.en: Were it possible to reverse the effects of deforestation, the biodiversity that has been lost over the past century might gradually recover.
sentences.zh: 如果有可能逆轉森林砍伐的影響，過去一個世紀失去的生物多樣性可能會逐漸恢復。

sentences.en: Suppose we were to implement universal basic income; the resulting economic effects, both positive and negative, would be profoundly transformative.
sentences.zh: 假設我們實施全民基本收入，由此產生的正面和負面經濟效應都將是深刻變革性的。

sentences.en: If the experiment had been conducted under controlled conditions, the results, now considered unreliable, might have been accepted by the scientific community.
sentences.zh: 如果實驗在受控條件下進行，現在被認為不可靠的結果可能已被科學界接受。

sentences.en: I wish I had taken the opportunity to study abroad when it was offered, as that experience would have broadened my perspective considerably.
sentences.zh: 我希望我在有機會時出國留學了，因為那個經歷會大大拓寬我的視野。

sentences.en: Should the company fail to adapt to changing market conditions, its long-term survival, already uncertain, would become virtually impossible.
sentences.zh: 如果公司未能適應不斷變化的市場條件，其已經不確定的長期生存將變得幾乎不可能。

sentences.en: If it were not for the dedicated volunteers who work tirelessly behind the scenes, this organization would have collapsed years ago.
sentences.zh: 如果不是那些在幕後不知疲倦工作的敬業志工，這個組織早在多年前就會崩潰了。

sentences.en: Imagine what the world would look like if every nation committed to eliminating poverty through coordinated, well-funded international programs.
sentences.zh: 想像一下如果每個國家都致力於通過協調的、資金充足的國際計劃消除貧困，世界會是什麼樣子。

sentences.en: Had we anticipated the magnitude of the crisis, preventive measures, which were ultimately implemented too late, could have minimized the damage.
sentences.zh: 如果我們預見到危機的嚴重程度，最終實施得太晚的預防措施本可以將損害降到最低。

sentences.en: If I were to choose between financial security and personal fulfillment, I would prioritize the latter, believing that happiness transcends material wealth.
sentences.zh: 如果我必須在經濟保障和個人成就之間做選擇，我會優先選擇後者，因為我相信幸福超越物質財富。

sentences.en: Without the breakthrough in medical research that occurred unexpectedly, the treatment options available to patients today would be far more limited.
sentences.zh: 如果沒有意外發生的醫學研究突破，今天患者可用的治療選項會受到更大的限制。

sentences.en: If only the warning signs had been recognized sooner, the catastrophic failure that disrupted operations for months could have been entirely prevented.
sentences.zh: 要是那些警告信號更早被認出來，中斷了數月運營的災難性故障本可以完全避免。

sentences.en: Assuming that the proposed legislation passes without amendment, businesses operating in the affected sectors would need to comply within twelve months.
sentences.zh: 假設提議的立法在未經修改的情況下通過，受影響行業的企業需要在十二個月內遵守。

sentences.en: Were the funding to be withdrawn at this critical juncture, all the progress made by the research team over five years would be jeopardized.
sentences.zh: 如果在這個關鍵時刻撤回資金，研究團隊五年來取得的所有進展都將受到威脅。

sentences.en: If we had embraced digital transformation earlier, our organization, now struggling to compete, would be in a significantly stronger market position.
sentences.zh: 如果我們更早擁抱數位轉型，我們現在正在努力競爭的組織將處於顯著更強的市場地位。

sentences.en: In a hypothetical scenario where artificial intelligence surpasses human intelligence, the ethical frameworks we currently rely on would require fundamental revision.
sentences.zh: 在人工智慧超越人類智慧的假設情境中，我們目前依賴的倫理框架將需要根本性的修訂。

sentences.en: I would have resigned immediately if my employer had asked me to compromise my professional ethics for the sake of increasing quarterly profits.
sentences.zh: 如果我的雇主要求我為了增加季度利潤而犧牲我的職業道德，我會立即辭職。

sentences.en: Should you encounter any difficulties during the implementation phase, please do not hesitate to contact the support team that has been assigned to your project.
sentences.zh: 如果你在實施階段遇到任何困難，請不要猶豫，聯繫已被分配到你專案的支援團隊。

sentences.en: If the theory were correct, we would expect to observe certain phenomena that, despite extensive searching, have never actually been documented.
sentences.zh: 如果該理論是正確的，我們會期望觀察到某些現象，但儘管進行了大量搜索，這些現象從未被實際記錄過。

sentences.en: Had it not been for the timely intervention of emergency responders, who arrived within minutes, the outcome could have been tragically different.
sentences.zh: 如果不是急救人員在幾分鐘內趕到的及時干預，結果可能會截然不同且令人悲痛。

sentences.en: Supposing that we could travel back in time, the knowledge we possess now would allow us to prevent countless mistakes made throughout history.
sentences.zh: 假設我們能回到過去，我們現在擁有的知識將使我們能夠防止歷史上犯下的無數錯誤。

sentences.en: If public transportation were more accessible and affordable, fewer people would rely on private vehicles, thereby reducing urban congestion significantly.
sentences.zh: 如果大眾運輸更加便利且負擔得起，更少的人會依賴私人車輛，從而顯著減少城市擁堵。

sentences.en: Were I given the chance to redesign the curriculum from scratch, I would incorporate real-world problem-solving exercises that prepare students for actual challenges.
sentences.zh: 如果我有機會從頭重新設計課程，我會納入為學生準備面對實際挑戰的真實世界問題解決練習。

sentences.en: If this trend continues unchecked for another decade, the consequences for public health, already visible in certain demographics, will become irreversible.
sentences.zh: 如果這個趨勢再不加以控制地持續十年，已經在某些人群中可見的公共健康後果將變得不可逆轉。

sentences.en: I would be far more supportive of the proposal if it included concrete measures to protect the interests of workers displaced by automation.
sentences.zh: 如果該提案包含保護被自動化取代的工人利益的具體措施，我會更加支持它。

sentences.en: Had the negotiations not broken down over the issue of territorial sovereignty, a lasting peace agreement might have been achieved decades ago.
sentences.zh: 如果談判沒有在領土主權問題上破裂，一個持久的和平協議可能在幾十年前就已經達成了。

sentences.en: In the event that the backup systems were to fail simultaneously, the entire network, serving millions of users, would experience a complete shutdown.
sentences.zh: 萬一備份系統同時故障，為數百萬用戶提供服務的整個網絡將經歷完全停擺。

sentences.en: If society valued teachers as highly as it values athletes and entertainers, the quality of education would improve dramatically within a generation.
sentences.zh: 如果社會像重視運動員和藝人一樣重視教師，教育品質將在一個世代內大幅提升。

sentences.en: Were we to apply the same rigorous standards to political discourse that we apply to scientific research, public debate would become far more productive.
sentences.zh: 如果我們將應用於科學研究的同樣嚴格標準應用於政治論述，公共辯論將變得更有成效。
